usedFor: Shopify records the order and ERP Docs prepares agreements. When an “Order Cancelled” fires in Shopify, “Create Document from Template” in ERP Docs can draft a cancellation or refund form from a template you already have.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Document from Template” in ERP Docs
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation is where paperwork is needed, and the draft is ready to review. The action sets sender, recipients, prefill, title and expiry days from a template.

watchOut: “Create Document from Template” makes an unsent draft, so nothing reaches the customer until someone sends it from ERP Docs.
